When Conflict Cannot Be Avoided

As factions expand and explore the world, they will inevitably encounter threats that cannot be solved through negotiation or investigation alone.

Hostile forces may control important territory.
Dangerous creatures may threaten nearby communities.
Corrupted structures may spread instability through the region.

When a faction must confront a major obstacle directly, the conflict is resolved through a Raid.

Raids represent large-scale confrontations where strategy, resources, and courage all matter.

What a Raid Represents

A raid is not just a fight between individuals.

It represents the organized effort of an entire faction attempting to overcome a powerful opponent.

During a raid, characters may:

• lead tactical efforts
• exploit weaknesses
• support allies
• confront powerful enemies directly

Meanwhile, the faction commits resources and coordination to support the operation.

The outcome reflects both player decisions and faction strategy.

When Raids Occur

Raids usually occur when a faction attempts to:

• capture or secure a hex
• defeat a powerful enemy
• destroy corrupted infrastructure
• defend territory from attack
• confront a dangerous boss

Raids may arise naturally during exploration or be launched intentionally by the faction.

Raid Maneuvers

During a raid, factions deploy maneuvers.

Maneuvers represent coordinated tactics used to gain an advantage during the conflict.

Examples of maneuvers include:

• flanking attacks
• defensive formations
• strategic disruptions
• coordinated assaults

Each maneuver represents a different tactical approach to the battle.

Choosing the right maneuvers at the right time can dramatically influence the outcome.

Characters in Raids

Although raids represent large-scale conflicts, characters still play a critical role.

Characters may:

• lead specialized actions
• exploit enemy weaknesses
• overcome key obstacles
• change the direction of the battle

Heroic actions during a raid can shift the balance between success and failure.

Raid Rounds

Raids usually unfold across a series of rounds.

Each round represents a moment in the larger struggle where both sides attempt to gain the advantage.

During a round:

  1. factions select their maneuvers

  2. resources are committed

  3. outcomes are determined

  4. the conflict evolves

The raid continues until one side achieves its objective or is forced to withdraw.

Raid Outcomes

Raids can end in several ways.

Possible outcomes include:

• decisive victory
• partial success
• stalemate
• costly failure

Each outcome creates consequences that affect the campaign world.

Victory might secure territory or eliminate a threat.

Failure may strengthen enemies or create new problems that must be addressed later.

Boss Raids

Some enemies are powerful enough to require specialized raid structures.

These Boss Raids represent confrontations with major threats that cannot be defeated easily.

Bosses often possess unique abilities or defenses that require careful planning to overcome.

Defeating a boss may dramatically alter the balance of power in a region.

Raids and Territory

Raids are often tied directly to control of hexes.

Factions may launch raids to:

• secure valuable territory
• remove dangerous enemies
• defend important infrastructure

Because of this, raids frequently shape the political and strategic map of the campaign.

Raids and the Great Work

Many of the most important steps toward restoring the world require confronting powerful forces.

Raids represent those moments when factions must stand against corruption, chaos, or destruction.

Victory in these struggles pushes the world closer to stability.

Failure may allow dangerous forces to spread further.

What Players Should Remember

Three ideas define raids in Bad Eden.

1 — Raids are organized faction conflicts

They represent large-scale struggles rather than simple fights.

2 — Strategy matters

The maneuvers and resources a faction commits influence the outcome.

3 — Characters can change the tide

Heroic actions during raids can dramatically affect the battle.

In Simple Terms

Raids are how factions confront the largest threats in the world.

They combine strategy, resources, and heroism to determine whether a faction succeeds or fails.

When diplomacy and exploration are not enough, raids decide the outcome.
